claims.claim: From: Herman van Hazendonk Add the binding for the Aptina (now ON Semiconductor) MT9M113 1.3 megapixel SoC image sensor with on-die ISP. The chip is used as the front (user-facing) camera on the HP TouchPad tablet and connects to the host SoC over MIPI CSI-2. The binding describes the chip's i2c address, optional reset and standby GPIOs, the per-supply regulators (VDD, VDD_IO, VDDA), the external clock input, and the CSI-2 endpoint pads exposed via the "port" subnode.
